scientific_purpose: Audit whether ME077 auxiliary real motion probability and learned mixture probability actually discriminate measured physical change, using identical 960 previously exposed real source queries across all five frozen original 102503-param models. No new fit, no untouched TEST, no architecture-superiority, deployment or policy claims.
real_source: Original BodenAI/RW-RL-HIL observed real joint and lag1 issued action traces from historical source FIT; exposed DEV, never independent
strict_claims: Real historical motion labels only for retrospective scoring; not available to forecast model
Task/source end is not verified robot success
Do not tune prediction thresholds or alter checkpoints on exposed results
Auxiliary global motion probability is not equivalent to the joint-wise mixture component probabilities
Actual motion is only 84 of 960 eligible original real queries; model gains on stationary state do not prove hazard discrimination

registered_metrics.uncertainty: 2000 paired 40-episode cluster bootstraps for rank and Brier differences, five model predictions averaged per observed real query; seed 77078
registered_metrics.interpretation: Descriptive original exposed DEV only. Hindsight prevalence baseline is not deployable; an adequate predictive risk head needs actual ranking utility, calibration and prospective verification.
